method: Ranked all 16 genuinely-READY Singy Kids DEFINE-phase tasks by literal fit to the mission Chain C pipeline (LOCAL LESSON CATALOG -> PARENT GATE -> EXERCISE SESSION -> RESULT VALIDATION -> PROGRESS SAVE -> CLOSE -> REOPEN -> RESTORE -> CORRUPTION RECOVERY -> EVIDENCE). PARENT_GATE_CONTRACT itself is OWNER_GATE (gated) and was excluded per the no-external-gated-tasks rule; a real, original parent-gate mechanism is instead implemented inside the selected chain, not by depending on the gated task.
selectionReason: Highest pipeline-fit score, TIED with TASK-08-00973-LOCAL_PROGRESS_CONTRACT at pipelineFit=3. TIE-BREAK: the mission's own pipeline ordering lists LOCAL LESSON CATALOG as stage 1 (of 10) and PROGRESS SAVE as stage 5 -- Offline Lessons corresponds to the earlier, broader stage that the rest of the pipeline (parent gate, exercise session, progress) is built around, whereas Local Progress covers only the narrower SAVE/CLOSE/REOPEN/RESTORE/CORRUPTION-RECOVERY portion. Offline Lessons' title also literally names the mandatory offline/no-network requirement that spans the ENTIRE required slice (not just the progress-save portion), matching the mission's explicit 'no external network requirement' criterion. The full pipeline (catalog, parent gate, exercise session, progress save/restore, corruption recovery) is implemented inside this single 4-task chain, following the same pattern as Batch 5's Creator Project Workspace chain (one chain internally implementing a full multi-stage vertical behavior, consistent with the program's proven disconnected leaf-group graph structure).
